notes.bytes: All strings are raw bytes; lengths and offsets are byte-based, NUL and invalid UTF-8 are preserved.
notes.errors: Catalog failures use RUN_HOST; file failures use FUNCTION: PATH: OS reason.
notes.lifetime: Default registries own standard collection lifetimes; handles are valid only for the active run. All collection types share a 65536-object allocation budget; clearing a collection does not reclaim an allocation.
notes.paths: Relative file paths use the process cwd without sandbox or root checks. Unix preserves native path bytes; Windows requires strict UTF-8 and supports long drive/UNC paths. Every platform rejects embedded NUL. Symlinks are followed; missing/broken paths and nonregular objects return false from file_exists, while other metadata errors trap.
notes.registration: Registry defaults install 72 built-ins; testing print/assertions remain explicit host registrations.
